note: Supplementary/correction file - NOT purely new vitolas. 'Fratello Camo' already exists on the site, but its single listed vitola ('Camo Cameroon Robusto', 5x50) does not match any documented Camo product from any source checked (halfwheel, Cigar Coop, retailers, or Fratello's own site) - no 'Cameroon wrapper' Camo product was found anywhere. Camo is actually a budget/bundle line (introduced 2019, made at La Aurora, Dominican Republic) sold as distinct COLOR/FLAVOR-named variants. Recommend treating the site's current 'Camo Cameroon Robusto' entry as likely incorrect/outdated rather than building on top of it.
